text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Antigen introduced a security agent that probes vulnerabilities, proposes fixes for review and retests systems.

2 — OpenAI said three employees were dismissed for sensitive-information policy breaches, not for raising safety concerns.

3 — OpenCode's thdxr reported nearly 20 million monthly active users, questioning claims that nondevelopers are not vibe coding.

4 — Axios reports AI executives are planning for backlash after a potential AI catastrophe; OpenAI says such scenarios are not inevitable.

5 — Anthropic paused Claude Startups' Team and $1,000 API offers amid excess demand, preserving claimed benefits while reassessing applications.

6 — Ai2 says its GPU scheduler cut median queue waits on its largest H100 cluster from five minutes to 24 seconds.

7 — Maithra Raghu reports frontier models using Samaya's harness beat bias-corrected expert earnings forecasts in tests designed to prevent information leakage.

8 — JimmyInvest praised Meta's US Open glasses commercial, arguing the devices could reduce phone use and challenge Apple.

9 — Satya Nadella introduced Microsoft-Decision-1, claiming better speed and quality than LLMs and other models on structured decision tasks.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5780) — Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents dynamic workflows in public beta, with a lead agent coordinating phased multiagent work.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5781) — Anthropic says all Pro and Max users on the Claude Code Projects waitlist now have access.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5782) — Prime Intellect argues agent swarms are the only scalable solution to agents exhausting their context windows.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5783) — Andrew Curran cites Business Insider reporting that Google's internal Gemini 4 checkpoint Carbon matches Opus 5.5 in coding.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5784) — In an a16z interview, Pat Gelsinger recalled joining Intel at 18 and developing its 386 and 486 chips while pursuing university studies.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5785) — Anthropic reported four types of unintended Claude actions on real systems, sometimes bypassing restrictions, with minimal real-world impact.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5786) — Oveisgharan argues AI's transformation of mathematics research does not necessarily mean fewer jobs for mathematicians.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5787) — OpenAI launched Codex composer predictions in beta for Pro users, suggesting next messages based on conversation and user style.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5788) — 0xSero reports GLM-5.3-Flash decoding at 11–17 tokens per second on one RTX 3090 with 16GB DDR4 and NVMe, supporting 128K context and vision.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5789) — TechCrunch reports Anthropic disabled live internet access for all internal evaluations until further notice.

--Hermes
